summary.zh: HoloBrain-0.5 把不同机器人的 URDF 统一成共享的 3D 运动学表示，在 1 万小时、15 类本体的数据上预训练扩散版与 FSQ 离散版两种 VLA；后训练后在 7 任务基准上 94.52% 对 π0.5 的 86.25%，且仅用少量 G1 演示就在人形任务上达到 70.24%。
summary.en: HoloBrain-0.5 encodes heterogeneous robot URDFs in one shared 3D kinematic representation and pretrains diffusion and FSQ-discrete VLAs on 10k hours across 15 embodiment types; after post-training it beats π0.5 on a 7-task benchmark (94.52% vs 86.25%) and reaches 70.24% on G1 humanoid tasks from few demos.

summary.zh: Aegis-VLA 用轨迹世界模型预测运动物体并给出不确定度，再由“可靠性门”决定是否、以多大幅度采纳动作修正；仅增加约 2.45M 参数，在 DOM 动态操作基准上成功率 56.72%，比复现的 DynamicVLA 高 11.28 个百分点。
summary.en: Aegis-VLA predicts moving-object trajectories with uncertainty using a trajectory world model, and a reliability gate decides whether and how much to apply action corrections; with ~2.45M extra parameters it reaches 56.72% on the DOM benchmark, +11.28 pp over DynamicVLA.

summary.zh: DexLink 把稀疏、可复用的手-物交互模板重定向到目标物体上，串成近似参考轨迹，再用残差 RL 在仿真里细化成闭环灵巧策略；无需物体专属的人类演示，即可控制时机与抓取类型，效果与稠密参考跟踪方法相当。
summary.en: DexLink retargets sparse, reusable hand-object templates to new objects, chains them into a rough reference, and refines it with residual RL into a closed-loop dexterous policy; it controls timing and grasp type without object-specific human demos and matches dense reference-tracking methods.

summary.zh: WorldReforge 用 6.2 万条扰动抓取的仿真失败轨迹（推、滑、抓空）训练机器人世界模型，加入交互区域对齐与表面点对应两个训练信号；在 Cosmos3 Nano 上物体轨迹误差降低 28.2%，对未见物体降低 35.0%。
summary.en: WorldReforge trains robot world models on 62k simulated failure trajectories (pushes, slips, missed grasps) with interaction-alignment and surface-correspondence losses, cutting object-trajectory error on Cosmos3 Nano by 28.2% overall and 35.0% on unseen objects.
